title: showcase: showcase_project_escalation fails terminally (CEL no such overload on null budget) whenever a project with no budget turns red, so the escalation notifies nobody

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 (examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts, `ProjectEscalationFlow` edges e2/e3) + 复现
reach: 公开入口实测一次错误结果 — `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"health":"red"}` on a project without a budget makes the flow run fail terminally (two fresh boots at 7fa9873f)
业务理由: the showcase is the reference app new users read and copy. Its escalation flow fails on an ordinary record (no budget, or no owner), so the "red project alerts someone" scenario it demonstrates does not happen, and the pattern it teaches (an unguarded comparison on an optional field) is the bug. Not doing it: the reference teaches a failing pattern and its own demo escalations notify nobody.
动手的读者: the domain:devx seat (example apps / dogfood); triage first touch confirms the lane, then os-dev.
查重: `showcase_project_escalation` → 3 hits, 0 open (#7746, #4414, #16405 closed, all different); `escalation budget null` → 187 hits, 1 open (#6367, a seat post). No duplicate.

QA-source: #28942 · records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix · observed beside the clauses

Path: `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` (`ProjectEscalationFlow`, edges e2/e3)

**What happens.** The flow triggers on `health == "red" && previous.health != "red"`, then branches at the `triage` decision on edge conditions `budget > 200000` (e2) and `budget <= 200000` (e3). `budget` is an optional currency field (`project.object.ts`) and nothing defaults it. For a project with no budget the CEL comparison has no overload for null, so the run dies at the decision. The server logs `ERROR Trigger-fired run of flow 'showcase_project_escalation' failed (trigger 'record_change') … "condition failed to evaluate as CEL: no such overload: dyn‹null› > int … budget > 200000"`; nothing retries, and neither the owner nor the exec is alerted. The record write itself succeeds (200).

**Reproduction** (stock `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, framework 7fa9873f; reproduced on two fresh boots):
1. Admin. `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_project {"name":"esc","account":"ANY_SHOWCASE_ACCOUNT_ID","status":"planned","health":"yellow","owner":"admin@objectos.ai"}` → 201 (no `budget`).
2. `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"health":"red"}` → 200.
3. The server log shows the ERROR line above; the flow run fails.
- Control: the same with `"budget":1000` → no error; the run takes e3 → notify_normal.

Related, on the same flow (seen once): a budgeted project with no owner fails at `notify_normal` with "notify: at least one recipient is required, but every recipient value expression evaluated to nothing: `has(record.owner) ? record.owner : null`". `owner` is optional too.

- Expected: the reference app's flow handles its own optional fields — guard the decision (`has(record.budget) && record.budget > 200000`, plus an otherwise edge), and route around the owner notify when there is no owner, as the node's own remedy text suggests.
- Actual: a terminal flow failure on an ordinary record.

Full evidence: QA run record #28942.
